about: Bright and nearby stars: ESA Hipparcos new reduction (van Leeuwen 2007) via the ESA Gaia archive, CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO. Names and constellation figures: d3-celestial (BSD-3-Clause). Columns: hip, ecliptic lon, lat (deg, J2000), distance (pc, 1/parallax), Hp mag, B−V, proper name, designation, parallax relative error.

gaia.format: uint16 lon, uint16 lat, uint16 log10 pc, uint8 G*20, uint8 (BP-RP+0.5)*50 (255 = none); lon/lat ecliptic J2000; log10 pc mapped from [-1, 4.5]
